Date: 2026-11-20T09:14:00-08:00
Subject: Draft order form and a couple of allocation questions

Karthik —

Thanks for sending the draft MSA last week. Procurement looped me in with a few follow-ups around the order form commercial schedule before we sign:

- Can invoices be split to two entities (NebulaHealth US for services consumed in the US; NebulaHealth UK for EU usage)? Procurement prefers entity-level invoices for VAT/GL mapping.
- Who is responsible for VAT reverse-charge / gross-up? We expect the receiving entity to handle VAT but need this explicit.
- Net terms: procurement is pushing for Net 45 rather than Net 30. Is that acceptable?

I attached our redline (NEB_OrderForm_Redline_v3.pdf) with comments inline — the main ask is clear mapping of pricing bands to entity remit and a short clause on tax responsibility. We can be flexible on min commits if we get the invoice routing and net terms aligned.

Proposed next step: 30-min call with legal + finance to lock allocation. Are you available Wednesday 11/24 morning PST?

Thanks,
Evan
Evan Cole
Head of Procurement, NebulaHealth

Kim / Lauren —

FYI inbound from NebulaHealth procurement. Key asks: invoice split by entity, clarity on VAT/gross-up, and a Net 45 request. They attached a redline.

Can legal review the attached and confirm:
1) Whether we can accept entity-split invoicing as proposed (we may need to add language that limits our liability to amounts invoiced to a given payee entity).
2) Tax clause: draft a one-sentence allocation of VAT/reverse-charge responsibility that doesn't create an indemnity.
3) Net 45: finance ok with an exception? Ben I cc'd — can you weigh in on cash flow impact and whether billing cadence needs to change if we accept Net 45?

If possible please circulate quick inline comments by EOD so I can reply to Evan and propose the sync slot.

Thanks —
Karthik
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-21T08:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Draft order form and a couple of allocation questions

Karthik —

I reviewed NEB_OrderForm_Redline_v3.pdf and drafted the following points for negotiation:

- Invoice routing / payee entity: Acceptable provided we add a clause that (a) ties unit pricing to the entity mapping table in the order form, and (b) caps our aggregate liability to amounts actually invoiced to the entity that paid (prevents cross-entity claims). I'll add a short sentence to that effect.

- Tax responsibility: Recommend language — "Each party is responsible for its own taxes. Where local law requires withholding or VAT gross-up, the relevant paying entity shall comply; Redwood will provide documentation needed for reclaim but will not assume gross-up liability unless explicitly agreed in writing." This avoids an indemnity while acknowledging evidence support.

- Net terms: Legal can agree to Net 45 as an exception but we should require a PO number on all invoices and keep a contractual right to suspend service for overdue amounts after a cure period. Finance input needed on receivables timing.

I attached a marked-up PDF with inline redlines. If finance approves the PO + Net 45 tradeoff we can accept.

-Kimberly
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

Date: 2026-11-22T11:40:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Order Form: invoice allocation & tax responsibility (NebulaHealth)

Thanks Kimberly and Karthik — that's helpful. A few clarifications from our side:

- PO requirement is fine; procurement will provide PO numbers per invoice. We'll add a short process: Nebula will push PO on the invoice and a billing contact will confirm remit entity in the invoice metadata.
- For VAT: our UK entity will accept VAT/responsibility; Nebula expects Redwood to provide VAT evidence (tax certificates) to help with reclaim. The procurement team does not expect Redwood to gross-up.
- Net 45: procurement requests Net 45 for annual contracts. If legal requires a service-suspension cure window, 30 days after due is acceptable.

We can do the sync on Thursday 11/24 10:00-10:30 PST. I'll send a calendar invite with procurement and finance.

Evan

Evan / team —

Thanks for the quick turnaround and for confirming PO flow. Summary of what Redwood can commit to and outstanding asks before the sync:

Mutual action plan (proposed)
- Redwood to add an "Entity Remit Table" to the order form mapping pricing bands to invoice payee entities (we'll attach as Appendix A).
- Legal to include the sentence Kimberly proposed on taxes (no gross-up liability; Redwood will provide reclaim documentation).
- Finance to accept Net 45 as a negotiated exception provided each invoice carries a valid PO number. Ben — please confirm if Net 45 is workable and whether we should require earlier milestone invoices to accelerate cash flow.
- Both parties to sign Order Form v3 after the 11/24 sync; if any redlines remain we'll capture them in the canary clause for first 90 days.

Proposed 30-min sync: 2026-11-24 10:00-10:30 PST (calendar invite forthcoming).

Please reply with any redline bake-in items. If no objections I'll share a short two-point agenda for the call (invoice routing & net terms + tax evidence logistics).

Thanks —
Karthik
